title: Purpose-bound verification relationship and confused-deputy resistance matrix
hypothesis: A synthetic purpose-bound authorization matrix can reject a verification method used outside its declared relationship or controller scope without claiming real-key validity, live DID resolution, or production interoperability.
null_or_failure: An authentication-only method signs an assertion, an assertion method invokes a capability, a controller mismatch passes, an unresolved reference grants authority, a revoked or absent method remains usable, or structural acceptance becomes production cryptographic assurance.
test_falsifier_or_gate: Exercise valid purpose, wrong purpose, controller mismatch, dangling reference, absent relationship, revoked method, duplicate method, and production-promotion fixtures; fail closed with zero real keys, proofs, resolvers, status services, or partners.
rollback_or_recovery: Reject the operation, retain the vector, restore the least-authority relationship map, and require standards-conformant real keys, proofs, live resolution and status, interoperability, privacy assurance, independent security review, and trust governance for production claims.
boundary: Synthetic purpose checks do not supply real keys, proofs, live resolution or status, interoperability, review, or governance.
